title: Kashmir Winter & Alpine Powder Expedition
tagline: Experience frozen Dal Lake, Gulmarg's 14,000-ft peaks, and pine-clad Pahalgam valleys with a curated small group.
overview: A meticulously designed 7-day winter journey across Kashmir based on Ashraf Siddiqui's field-tested route. Covering Srinagar heritage houseboats, the frozen wonderland of Sonmarg and Thajiwas Glacier, 14,000-ft Apharwat Peak at Gulmarg via the Gondola, the pristine valleys of Pahalgam (Betaab, Aru & Chandanwari), and authentic street food walks in Lal Chowk.
highlights: 2 nights aboard a traditional cedarwood heritage houseboat on peaceful Dal/Nigeen Lake
Full day Sonmarg exploration to Thajiwas Glacier and the historic wooden bridge
Gondola Phase 1 & 2 tickets to 13,780 ft on Apharwat Peak plus frozen Drung Waterfall
Overnight stay in Pahalgam with Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari excursions
Authentic Srinagar street food walk in Lal Chowk and multi-course Wazwan feast
Curated small-group experience capped strictly at 10–12 fellow travelers
inclusions: All accommodation (Double-occupancy in boutique heritage stays, Pahalgam hotel & heated houseboats)
Daily breakfast and traditional Kashmiri dinners throughout the 7 days
Private dedicated mountain transport with professional local drivers and winter tire chains
Gondola cable car passes for Apharwat Peak in Gulmarg
Sunset Shikara ride on iconic Dal Lake
Certified local mountain guides and 24/7 expedition host support
All driver allowances, fuel, tolls, and intercity permits
exclusions: Airfare or train transit to and from Srinagar / Jammu
Lunches, personal snacks, and extra Kehwa outside scheduled meals
Winter gear rental (heavy snow jackets/boots) if you do not bring your own
Personal expenses, shopping, pony rides, and optional ski equipment

dayWiseItinerary.title: Transit to Srinagar & Dal Lake Welcome
dayWiseItinerary.description: Scenic transit to Srinagar through mountain corridors. Check in to your heritage hotel or handcrafted cedarwood houseboat on Dal Lake. In the evening, take a leisurely stroll through the local market, savor hot saffron Kehwa, and enjoy your welcome Kashmiri dinner.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar to Sonmarg & Thajiwas Glacier Exploration
dayWiseItinerary.description: Morning drive (approx 100 km, 2.5–3 hours) along the Sindh River to Sonmarg ('Meadow of Gold' at 8,950 ft). Explore the snow-clad valley and hike or take a pony ride to the majestic Thajiwas Glacier viewpoint. Enjoy hot Maggi and Kehwa amidst towering Himalayan peaks. On the return drive, stop at the historic wooden bridge of Sonmarg before returning to Srinagar by evening.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg, Drung Waterfall & Gondola Ride (14,000 ft)
dayWiseItinerary.description: Early 7:30 AM departure to beat traffic. Visit the frozen Drung Waterfall near Tangmarg cascading down pine-clad cliffs. Ascend to Gulmarg (2,650 m) through dense snow-covered pine forests. Ride the world-famous Gulmarg Gondola: Phase 1 (Kongdoori) and Phase 2 (Apharwat Peak at 13,780 ft) for breathtaking views of the Pir Panjal range. Enjoy sledging, snow activities, and pine forest walks before returning to Srinagar.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam — Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari
dayWiseItinerary.description: Scenic morning drive past the saffron fields of Pampore and historic Awantipora temple ruins toward Pahalgam ('Valley of Shepherds') along the Lidder River. Explore the emerald pine meadows of Betaab Valley, scenic Aru Valley, and the snowy gateway of Chandanwari. Evening riverside stroll and bonfire.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Return to Srinagar — Dal Lake Shikara Drift & Mughal Gardens
dayWiseItinerary.description: Morning peace in Pahalgam before driving back to Srinagar. Settle into Srinagar and embark on a serene 2-hour Shikara ride across Dal Lake. Explore the royal Mughal heritage: Nishat Bagh (Garden of Bliss), Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and sunset at Pari Mahal (Palace of Fairies) overlooking Dal Lake, followed by a visit to Hazratbal Shrine.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Srinagar Heritage Trail — Lal Chowk & Authentic Wazwan Food Walk
dayWiseItinerary.description: Discover the vibrant heartbeat of Srinagar at Lal Chowk and the Clock Tower. Explore traditional pashmina and spice bazaars. Enjoy an authentic street food walk trying Seekh Kebabs, Girda Bread, Rajma Chawal, Kalari Kulcha, and traditional pink Noon Chai. In Dal Lake (Ghat No. 6), indulge in authentic Wazwan specialties including Rogan Josh, Yakhni, Dum Aloo, and Kashmiri Pulao. Evening illuminated city walk.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Souvenir Keepsakes & Departure Day
dayWiseItinerary.description: Enjoy a final morning cup of steaming saffron Kehwa. Check out from your stay and do last-minute shopping for pure saffron, walnuts, and Kashmiri handicrafts. Transfer to Srinagar Airport / Jammu transit with lifelong memories of the paradise on earth.

faqs.question: How cold will it get in Kashmir during February?
faqs.answer: Daytime temperatures in Srinagar range from 5°C to 12°C, dropping to -2°C to 2°C at night. In Gulmarg, temperatures can plunge to -8°C at night. All our accommodations feature traditional bukhari wood heaters or central electric heating with heated electric blankets.

faqs.question: Can beginners join this trip? Is high fitness required?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! This is an experiential expedition suitable for travelers of average fitness. Walking in snow is slow and peaceful. Crampons and walking sticks are provided for ridge walks.

faqs.question: What is the group size and who else travels?
faqs.answer: The group is strictly capped at 12 people. Our community comprises photographers, solo professionals, creatives, and adventure enthusiasts aged between 22 and 45. Solo travelers are warmly welcomed and matched with a same-gender roommate.

faqs.question: What is the booking and payment process?
faqs.answer: In this phase, submitting your registration reserves your seat enquiry without immediate card payment. Our team verifies seat availability and contacts you on WhatsApp within 24 hours to confirm your spot with an advance deposit.

host.name: Ashraf Siddiqui
host.message: I personally lead every minute of this journey. We travel slow, respect local communities, and create genuine bonds that outlive the trip.

title: Spiti Valley Middle Land 4x4 Circuit
tagline: Traverse high Himalayan mountain passes, thousand-year-old Tibetan monasteries, and the world's highest post office.
overview: A rugged overland journey through the Middle Land connecting Tibet and India. Crossing Kunzum Pass, staying in ancient village homestays like Langza, and gazing into the starlit void at 14,000 feet.
highlights: Send a postcard from the World's Highest Post Office in Hikkim (14,567 ft)
Stay in mud-brick homestays in Langza under the shadow of Chau Chau Kang Nilda peak
Explore 1000-year-old Key Monastery and meditate with resident monks
Drive across Asia's highest suspension bridge at Chicham (13,596 ft)
Camp beside the celestial crescent waters of Chandratal Lake
inclusions: 9 nights stay in local homestays and alpine camps
Breakfast and dinners daily (nutritious local vegetarian meals)
High ground clearance 4x4 vehicles with experienced mountain drivers
Permits, entry fees, and oxygen cylinders in every vehicle
Expedition leader and local Spitian community coordinator
exclusions: Travel from your home city to Shimla

dayWiseItinerary.title: Shimla to Sangla Valley
dayWiseItinerary.description: Drive along Hindustan-Tibet road through Kinnaur gorges.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Sangla to Kalpa & Kinner Kailash Views
dayWiseItinerary.description: Visit Chitkul (last Indian village) and watch sunset over sacred Kinner Kailash.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Kalpa to Nako & Tabo Monastery
dayWiseItinerary.description: Cross into Spiti district; visit thousand-year-old UNESCO Tabo mud monastery.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Tabo to Dhankar Fort & Kaza
dayWiseItinerary.description: Climb Dhankar monastery perched on cliff edge; reach Spiti headquarters in Kaza.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Key Monastery & Kibber High Village
dayWiseItinerary.description: Morning prayers at Key Monastery; explore Kibber wildlife sanctuary.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Hikkim, Komic & Langza Fossil Village
dayWiseItinerary.description: Send postcards from Hikkim; explore Langza prehistoric marine fossils.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Chicham Bridge & Chandratal Lake
dayWiseItinerary.description: Cross Chicham gorge; camp beside the moon lake Chandratal at 14,100 ft.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Chandratal over Rohtang Pass to Manali
dayWiseItinerary.description: Navigate raw river crossings and boulder beds; cross Rohtang Pass to Manali.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Manali Leisure & Cafe Stroll
dayWiseItinerary.description: Relax aching muscles in natural hot springs; celebration dinner in Old Manali.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Departure from Manali
dayWiseItinerary.description: Overnight Volvo bus or airport transfer to Kullu/Chandigarh.

faqs.question: Is Spiti suitable for first-time high-altitude travelers?
faqs.answer: We take the gradual ascent route via Shimla and Kinnaur, allowing your body to adapt slowly to altitude over 4 days before reaching Kaza.

faqs.question: Will my phone work in Spiti?
faqs.answer: Only BSNL and Jio postpaid connections receive network coverage in Kaza. Enjoy the digital detox!

host.name: Ashraf Siddiqui
host.message: Spiti strips life to its raw essentials. You will return transformed.

title: Ladakh High Passes Overland Expedition
tagline: Overland 10-day circuit crossing Khardung La, Nubra cold desert dunes, Turtuk village, and Pangong Tso.
overview: A bucket-list overland Himalayan crossing across the highest motorable roads on planet Earth. Built with mandatory 48-hour acclimatization in Leh, double-humped camel safaris in Hunder, and starlit camps along the Tibetan border.
highlights: Khardung La Pass crossing at 17,982 ft
Stargazing camps beside the changing blues of Pangong Tso
Visit Turtuk — India's northernmost Balti border village
Morning prayers at 15th-century Thiksey Monastery
Small group capped at 12 participants
inclusions: 9 nights stay (Boutique guesthouse in Leh, luxury tents in Nubra & Pangong)
Daily breakfast and dinners
All Inner Line Permits and Wildlife / Environmental fees
Private Innova / Scorpio vehicles with oxygen support
Certified local guide and expedition host

dayWiseItinerary.title: Touchdown in Leh & Compulsory Rest
dayWiseItinerary.description: Arrive at 11,500 ft; mandatory 24-hr rest to acclimatize safely.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Indus Valley Monasteries & Shanti Stupa
dayWiseItinerary.description: Visit Thiksey, Shey Palace, and sunset at Shanti Stupa.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Crossing Khardung La into Nubra Valley
dayWiseItinerary.description: Ascend 17,982 ft pass; descend into Hunder sand dunes.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Turtuk Balti Border Village
dayWiseItinerary.description: Walk through apricot orchards in Turtuk; meet local Balti elders.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Shyok River Route to Pangong Tso
dayWiseItinerary.description: Overland gorge drive along turquoise river; arrive at Pangong Lake.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Pangong Sunrise & Return over Chang La
dayWiseItinerary.description: Cross 17,590 ft Chang La; visit Hemis Monastery; return to Leh.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Magnetic Hill, Sangam & Alchi Frescoes
dayWiseItinerary.description: Confluence of Indus & Zanskar rivers; 11th-century frescoes at Alchi.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Leh Palace, Tsemo Fort & Local Bazaars
dayWiseItinerary.description: Explore historic Leh Palace; shop for pashmina and apricots.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Stok Village Cultural Day & Farewell Feast
dayWiseItinerary.description: Visit Stok royal museum; celebration dinner with Tibetan dishes.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Departure from Leh Airport
dayWiseItinerary.description: Morning flights home over the snow peaks of Karakoram.

faqs.question: Is oxygen provided in vehicles?
faqs.answer: Yes, every vehicle carries medical oxygen canisters and oximeters for daily monitoring.

faqs.question: What permits are needed?
faqs.answer: All Inner Line Permits are handled by our team before you land.

host.name: Ashraf Siddiqui
host.message: Ladakh will change your perspective on size and stillness forever.

Boat ride on the glass-like waters of Umngot River in Dawki
Explore Mawlynnong (Asia's cleanest village)
Stand at the edge of Nohkalikai Falls in Cherrapunji
inclusions: 6 nights stay in boutique eco-resorts and homestays
Breakfast and dinners
Private AC vehicle transfers

dayWiseItinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong
dayWiseItinerary.description: Scenic drive past Umiam Lake; cafe evening in Shillong.

dayWiseItinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji

dayWiseItinerary.title: Nongriat Root Bridge Trek
dayWiseItinerary.description: 3,000 stone steps down to the living bio-engineered wonder.
